scope: PR #160 system fallback, numeric nameserver scopes and selected-server protocol errors

system_fallback.oracle: Actual glibc getaddrinfo and UDP DNS in private user, mount and network namespaces, with hosts: dns and search corp.test; no mock resolver or host configuration change.

development_failures.classification: Fixture import failure, not DNS runtime regression proof.
Compilation failed because internal visibility does not cross sibling Cangjie packages. The filename is not a PASS claim.

decisions: Only DnsClient uses the exact-name path. Existing SystemResolver resolve overloads retain their platform search behavior.
The cross-package bridge is in wirestack.internal.resolver and is not re-exported through the supported public packages.
Nameserver scope IDs lose leading zeros; numeric zero becomes an absent zone before endpoint comparison.
Protocol errors retain code, native code, available endpoints and cause; terminal context classification retains the selected nameserver.
Retry attempts reuse one owned nameserver snapshot instead of cloning it for sizing and every pass.
stage_note: The network red/green and namespace red/green are separate development stages; complete acceptance is recorded by task-check.json.
